lines.text: Dessert is on the house today!

data.define: Used when a restaurant gives you something for free.

example.text: Dessert is on the house today!

misuse.text: Don't say 'on the house' about a real house.
misuse.why: It means free from the business.

publish.title: What does "on the house" mean?
publish.value: On the house = It's free, from the owner. Example: "Dessert is on the house today!" (casual English, US).
